name: split-testing
description: Design and run blinded comparative tests of any alternatives with variable conditions, runs, rounds, models, agents, and reviewers, including when a decision has no ready-made test tasks. Use for split testing, A/B or multi-way comparisons, repeated trials, blind evaluation, or evidence that one option performs better than another.
